remarks: BEST & FINAL BY 5:00 MONDAY, FEBRUARY 23rd. Tucked away on coveted Murray St in desirable Wolfpit, this charming 1947 storybook Cape is ready for its next chapter. Inside you will find a welcoming living room anchored by a classic stone fireplace, an inviting eat-in-kitchen featuring colorful Mexican tile floors, and a seamless flow to a screened-in-porch - ideal for morning coffee or evening relaxation. The main level primary bedroom is complete with a sitting area, adding comfort and flexibility to the layout. The family room completes the main level. Downstairs, the walk-out lower level opens directly to the patio and backyard, creating an easy indoor-outdoor connection for entertaining. A rare find in an exceptional and convenient location, this home checks all the boxes: charm, character, potential and an address that simply can't be beat minutes to shopping, I95 and the train. A true Wolfpit gem waiting to shine again! Gas Water Heater is approximately 3 years old. Furnace is approximately 4 years old. Roof is approximately 12 years old. Sold AS IS.
